object.name: evi_overdrive_wrap
object.digest: Antialiased atan-based saturation with shape input to control overdrive and gain wrapping
object.description: This atan() overdrive is a simple but deluxe memoryless nonlinear processor with atan() gain wrapping around it's core nonlinearity (controlled via inlet 2) and various antialiasing options. The object can be driven very hard and maintains stability and clean/dirty sound.

inlets.name: shape
inlets.digest: Linear gain 1..100 (0..40 dB). This actually controls a reciprocal gain wrapping around the internal saturator. The object handles high gain very well with minimal aliasing. This inlet corresponds to the equivalent inlet of the MSP 'overdrive~' object.

outlets.name: atan(x)
outlets.digestauto: Output - antialiased for your audio not for Maths

outlets.name: reset
outlets.digest: A sample accurate reset 'click' whenever the 'aa' or 'hfcompensate' attributes are changed. Might be useful.

attributes.name: aa
attributes.description: The 'aa' ('Anti Aliasing') method used. 0=Adaa1, 1=Adaa1 2x oversampled, 2=Adaa1 4x oversampled, 3=Adaa2 (default), 4=Adaa2 2x oversampled, 5=Adaa2 4x oversampled. 0..5 does not necessarily mean increasing in quality, it really depends on your audio input material. Experimentation is encouraged.

attributes.name: hfcompensate
attributes.description: The object provides a high frequency compensation 'decorelation' filter on its output for restoring the reduced high frequency response that can occur with this type of antialiasing, especially when utilising the oversampling options (as opposed to just using pure 'adaa'). Experiment with turning this on to improve high frequencies (default on).
